items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Another one was with, a close one was with Chick Webb when he had Ella Fitzgerald when she had just made "A Tiskit a Taskit".

ctx.x: But we had the battle and there wasn't any doubt about who won it and nobody, they would always say Lionel had a very good band, but we won the battle.
Another one was with, a close one was with Chick Webb when he had Ella Fitzgerald when she had just made "A Tiskit a Taskit".
But you were supposed to have won that.
